mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCalls, COALESCE(SUM(success), 0) AS successCalls, COALESCE(AVG(latency_ms), 0) AS avgLatencyMs, COALESCE(SUM(prompt_tokens), 0) AS sumPromptTokens, COALESCE(SUM(completion_tokens), 0) AS sumCompletionTokens, COALESCE(SUM(estimated_cost_usd), 0) AS sumEstimatedCostUsd FROM ai_call_audit
